question: The rate at which the Reserve Bank is ready to buy or rediscount bills of exchange or other commercial papers is called the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank Rate.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bank Rate** is the rate at which the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** is ready to buy or rediscount **bills of exchange **or other commercial papers from **commercial banks or financial institutions.**
